temperature.source: NASA POWER monthly (https://power.larc.nasa.gov), parameter T2M (air temperature at 2 m)

rainfall.source: NASA POWER monthly (https://power.larc.nasa.gov), parameter PRECTOTCORR (corrected precipitation)

drought.source: Computed by us from NASA POWER rainfall (PRECTOTCORR) with the standard SPI method (McKee et al. 1993)
drought.unit: SPI-3: 3-month Standardized Precipitation Index (below -1 dry, below -2 very dry, above +1 wet)
drought.method: 3-month rainfall totals; gamma distribution fitted per calendar month over 1981-2025; zero totals as a separate probability (middle of tied rank); scores limited to -3..+3

vegetation.source: NASA MODIS MOD13A3.061 monthly NDVI via AppEEARS (https://appeears.earthdatacloud.nasa.gov)
vegetation.unit: NDVI greenness index (0 = bare ground, about 0.6+ = dense green)
vegetation.qualityKey: MODIS pixel reliability: 0 = good, 1 = marginal, 3 = cloudy (value less trustworthy)

earthquakes.source: USGS Earthquake Catalog ComCat (non-NASA), magnitude 4.5+, within 300 km of the city

projection.source: World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal, CMIP6 (cmip6-x0.25), 50th percentile (median of models), region: islamabad. Scenarios SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5. Projections, not measurements.
projection.method: Each 20-year window mean is placed at the middle of the window (2030, 2050, 2070, 2090). The portal's values are change from its recent-past baseline (believed 1995-2014, not stated in the file); we add this city's measured 1995-2014 mean anomaly (0.15 C) to express them against our 1981-2010 baseline. Monthly shape = average month-minus-annual-mean over the four windows.
